CRP (C-reactive protein) is a measure of overall systemic inflammation.
Typically, the more overweight or out of shape you are, the greater your
inflammatory levels. The desired range is less than 0.8 mg/L.
_______
An athlete’s health is pivotal to their ability to train, perform, and recover
optimally. This is the essence of the Human First paradigm, and elite
performance staff in professional sport across the world now understand
this deep connection. As Hippocrates, the “Father of Medicine,” once said:
“Health is the greatest of human blessings.” We often don’t appreciate our
good health until we don’t have it, athletes included. Ensuring adequate
sleep, gut diversity, and ideal glucose control are all strategies to support
athlete health. And now that you’ve dialed into your foundational health,
you’re ready to train and compete.
